document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Police cars come screeching up to the museum. You have several 
options, and should think about them all before choosing one:
You can attempt a Stealth roll: if successful, you get away, go 
to 301. If you fail, you can greet the police and admit what you’ve 
done, go to 315; or you can try to make a successful Fast Talk 
or Persuade roll to pass through the growing cordon of police. 
If you succeed with either roll, go to 301; if you fail, go to 315.
Or is there something else you want to try? If so, write it 
down and go to 249.
